body.question: In Asch's line task, actors unanimously gave the wrong answer. What percentage of the real participants' responses went along with them?
body.reveal: 35.7% of responses followed the actors' wrong answer, while 64.3% stayed correct. Without actors the error rate was under 0.7%. About 12% followed the group nearly always, 26% consistently defied it, and about 95% defied the majority at least once.

probes.question: True or false: in Asch's actor condition, most of the participants' responses followed the actors' wrong answer.
About what share of participants defied the majority at least once?

image_brief.show: File:Psychology-asch-1951.png shows the Asch line comparison cards

claims.claim: Actors unanimously gave the wrong answer on critical trials
claims.quote: They would always unanimously nominate one comparator

claims.claim: 35.7% of responses conformed to the actors' wrong answer
claims.quote: a sizable minority of responses conformed to the actors' (incorrect) answer (35.7%)

claims.claim: 64.3% stayed correct; so most responses did not follow the actors (probe 1)
claims.quote: the majority of participants' responses remained correct (64.3%)

claims.claim: Without actors the error rate was under 0.7%
claims.quote: In the control group, with no pressure to conform to actors, the error rate on the critical stimuli was less than 0.7%

claims.claim: About 12% followed the group nearly always; 26% consistently defied it
claims.quote: 12% of participants followed the group in nearly all of the tests. 26% of the sample consistently defied majority opinion

claims.claim: About 95% defied the majority at least once (probe 2)
claims.quote: No text mentioned that 95% of subjects defied the majority at least once.
claims.note: Page states the 95% figure in a sentence about textbooks omitting it.
